{{Quote|The vault contains documents from companies that handle the Republic's weapons programs--evidence of aborted experiments, biological accidents, minutes of secret meetings. With that evidence, we could blackmail the manufacturers to work for us instead of the Republic.|[[Cathan Dru]]|<ref name="TOR:SA" />}}
The '''Steelfast Data Haven''' was a secured data vault of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was guarded by [[Revaak]] and his [[Revaak's mercenaries|mercenaries]], who were all defeated by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] operatives sent there by [[Cathan Dru]].<ref name="TOR:SA" />
